title: Tes Banting Semen 50 Kg, Plat Kereta Sorong Five Star Tetap Kokoh
hook: Gerobak murah dilempar semen langsung penyok rangkanya
story: Sejak detik 0.0s di area proyek bangunan, satu karung semen 50 kg dijatuhkan dari atas dada langsung ke dalam bak merah Kereta Sorong Five Star dengan debu mengepul dan suara benturan mantap. Bak plat baja tebal Five Star tidak penyok dan rangkanya tidak bengkok. Mandor berpengalaman menepuk bibir bak gerobak dengan sarung tangan kerja, lalu menatap kamera dengan tenang dan berwibawa menyampaikan bahwa Kereta Sorong Five Star dari PT Intan Suar Kartika tahan banting di medan kerja berat.
caption:
Gerobak murah dilempar muatan semen langsung melengkung rangkanya, kerja proyek jadi kacau. Kereta Sorong Five Star dari PT Intan Suar Kartika bak plat baja tebal tahan banting, spek lengkap silakan kirim pesan ke DM.

shots.prompt: Photorealistic live-action video, vertical 9:16, 12 seconds, one continuous take, shot on a smartphone vlog camera at chest height with gentle natural handheld camera sway, authentic construction documentary look, natural neutral daylight 5500K, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary footage, clean frame without camera HUD, no REC icon, no viewfinder brackets, no on-screen text or captions of any kind. Location: an active building construction site yard in Medan, stacks of red bricks and gravel in the background, bright natural daylight. The wheelbarrow is exactly the product in the single attached official reference photo: bright glossy red pressed-steel tray, red tubular steel frame, white FIVE STAR sticker on the left handle, thick treaded pneumatic tyre. An Indonesian construction foreman about 42 years old in a dusty grey work shirt, dark work trousers, brown cotton work gloves and a yellow safety helmet stands beside the wheelbarrow. PROP CONTINUITY RULE: from 0.0s to 12.0s exactly one glossy red Kereta Sorong Five Star wheelbarrow, one heavy sack of cement in the tray, and the foreman are present; no extra carts, tools, people, or vehicles appear, shift, float, or disappear, and the red tray and FIVE STAR branding must remain consistent throughout. BEATS: at 0.0s in the very first frame, a heavy sack of cement drops into the red wheelbarrow tray with a firm thud and a tiny puff of grey dust, the red steel tray stays rigid and does not dent or buckle, while the foreman looks at it and speaks in calm authoritative Indonesian with accurate lip sync, "Gerobak murah dilempar semen langsung penyok rangkanya". From 3.5s to 7.0s he firmly taps the rim of the red steel tray twice with his gloved hand to prove its solid thickness, then grips the sturdy red handles to show the frame is perfectly straight. From 7.0s to 10.5s he turns his head to face the lens, resting his gloved hand calmly on the front rim, and says with steady pride, "Kereta Sorong Five Star PT Intan Suar Kartika tahan banting". From 10.5s to 12.0s he holds a confident nod while the red cart with the FIVE STAR logo remains clearly visible in frame. Calm authoritative mandor tempo, natural pauses between sentences, ambient construction site sound with dull metallic thuds and distant breeze, no music.
